name: orbitring
description: OrbitRing — radial actions menu and mouse button remapper for any mouse
author: S1LV4 (https://github.com/S1LV4)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/service && npm run build:ring -w packages/ring && npm run build -w packages/ui
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/service && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ring && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:ci -w packages/ring && npm run test:e2e -w packages/ui
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:system && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w packages/ring
